raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (327 rows, source_tz='UTC') sent txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch uses America/Chicago local time. The pipeline casts txn_ts without converting, so the late-evening 2026-01-17 Chicago transactions are shifted 6 hours and land on 2026-01-18 between 00:00 and 06:00. Converting the UTC rows to Chicago time puts the batch 13 samples at 06:00 CST, which matches the opening-hours pattern of the other batches.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
